articles.summary: 2 NEW AIRCRAFT ($200M INVESTMENT), 17 NEW ROUTES, & 5.3M LOW FARE SEATS Ryanair, Europe’s No.1 airline, today (Thurs, 6 Aug) announced its biggest ever Winter schedule in Morocco, offering 5.3m low-fares seats to/from 156 destinations, including 17 exciting new routes.
